question: How should all ṛṣis be satisfied according to this instruction?
premises: ārṣeṇa eva tu tīrthena specifies method
ṛṣīn sarvāṃśca tarpayet directs satisfying all ṛṣis
inference: All ṛṣis should be satisfied by the holy-place method, indeed by the ṛṣi method.
plain_english: Indeed by the ṛṣi method, but by the holy place, one should satisfy all the ṛṣis.
